transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. We need to finalize the review of the new ephemeral runner replacement before we can publish the operating policy. I know it passed the standard build-speed and failure-recovery tests in staging, and the draft policy currently allows 20 concurrent jobs with 30-day log retention. Before I give my final approval, I want to hear from each of you — developer productivity, site reliability, and compliance — on whether you see any issues or gaps we need to address. Let's start with your assessments.
